about: Files npm run i18n:extract skips, each with the reason. A single line can be skipped with a trailing // i18n-ignore comment.

files.src/i18n/format.ts: Locale tables (month and weekday names, day periods) per language, not interface copy.
files.src/i18n/locale.ts: Language names in their own language (Español, English), shown untranslated on purpose.
files.src/assistant/fixtures.ts: Development-only scripted model replies (content, not interface copy); never in a release bundle.
files.src/integrations/evidence.ts: Protocol labels sent to the Assistant server; the interface shows evidence from fact ids.
files.src/storage/database.ts: Storage errors, translated at display time by src/i18n/errors.ts from their exact text.
files.src/storage/transaction.ts: Storage errors, translated at display time by src/i18n/errors.ts.
files.src/storage/LedgerProvider.tsx: Storage errors, translated at display time by src/i18n/errors.ts.
files.src/i18n/regions/data.ts: Generated region catalogue (CLDR codes and conventions), not interface copy.
files.src/i18n/regions/es.ts: Generated region names from CLDR (data, not interface copy); the chooser shows them as CLDR wrote them.
files.src/i18n/regions/en.ts: Generated region names from CLDR (data, not interface copy); the chooser shows them as CLDR wrote them.
files.src/i18n/region-release.ts: The regions' release plan (stage ids and the purpose of each device check) for developers and the checklist; never shown in the app.
files.src/i18n/region-stages.ts: The regions' release stages and the blocker of the held-back stage, for developers and the checklist; never shown in the app.
files.src/fx/frankfurter.ts: The rate provider's client (24C1): its source name is a proper noun passed into catalogue sentences, and its errors are internal (the screens say why from fx.reason.*), never shown.
files.src/fx/rates-store.ts: The rate cache's bookkeeping (24C1): types and timing only, no interface copy.
files.src/storage/rates-database.ts: The rate cache's SQLite schema (24C1): SQL and types, no interface copy.
